notes: Genre: Puzzle. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Picture riddles: find the listed objects hidden in busy photo scenes before time runs out.
widgets.label: How it plays

widgets.text: Each scene lists objects in a rhyme; tap/move the cursor and press A on each one.
widgets.label: Riddles

widgets.text: Scan the scene in strips, edges first. Small objects hide in patterns of the same colour.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Themed picture scenes grouped into challenges; clearing them opens more.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text: Hints are limited: save them for the last object in a scene.
widgets.label: Hints

widgets.text: Every completed scene is kept; replay for faster times.
widgets.label: Collect
